Looking at the error message and the code, I can see several issues that need to be fixed:

1. The `gemmini_mx_read_smem` call has incorrect addressing - it's trying to read BF16 elements but calculating the address incorrectly
2. The output stride configuration doesn't match the actual output layout
3. The way we're reading results from shared memory is incorrect

Let me fix these issues:

```c
// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul baseline (1x1024x1024).
void solution(void) {
  for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
    for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
      // Partial last M/N block: compute only the real rows/cols, pad the rest.
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; if (mrows <= 0) continue;
      int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; if (ncols <= 0) continue;
      
      // Stage only the tiny per-32-group scales; A/B data is mvin'd DIRECTLY
      // from DRAM (no host-side block memcpy).
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], BLK);
        memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], BLK);
      }
      
      int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division for tiles
      int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM;  // Ceiling division for tiles
      int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_J * tiles_K * DIM;
      int SPAD_DEST = 0;  // Start from beginning of shared memory
      int pad_i = tiles_I * DIM - mrows, pad_j = tiles_J * DIM - ncols;
      
      gemmini_flush(0);
      
      // 1. Configure execution format and dataflow
      gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);
      
      // 2. Load Scale Factors
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);
      
      // 3. Load A Tiles (Contiguous Layout)
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t)); // A rows: stride K
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }
      
      // 4. Load B Tiles (Corrected Contiguous Layout)
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // B rows: stride N
      for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                                b_base + (j * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }
      
      // 5. Configure Output Requantizer
      gemmini_config_st(MATMUL_N * sizeof(out_t)); // Stride should match full N dimension
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);
      
      // 6. Fused Hardware Compute Loop
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
      
      // 7. Read Results out of Shared Memory
      // Results are packed 4 BF16 values per uint64 word
      int bf16_cols = (ncols + 3) / 4 * 4;  // Round up to nearest multiple of 4
      for (int r = 0; r < mrows; r++) {
        int words_to_read = (ncols + 3) / 4;  // Number of 64-bit words needed
        gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[i0 * BLK + r][j0 * BLK],
                             SPAD_DEST * 16 + r * bf16_cols, ncols);
      }
      
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
```
